# Aetheris — Revenue Systems for Specialty Manufacturers

> Aetheris helps specialty manufacturers ($5M–$25M revenue, US-based) find the $200K–$2M they're losing to broken CRM, sales follow-up, and operational systems — and fix it. Indianapolis-based. 21-Day Revenue Diagnostic at $18,500 fixed fee. Implementation Retainer at $15K/month for Diagnostic clients.

## The two offers (the only two)
1. **21-Day Revenue Diagnostic — $18,500 fixed fee.** Map every leak in CRM, sales follow-up, and lead flow. Written report with prioritized fixes, ROI projections, and an implementation roadmap. CRM-agnostic — runs on a CSV export of contacts, deals, and activity. HubSpot / Salesforce live integration is an upsell, not a prerequisite.
   See: https://aetheris.technology/diagnostic
2. **Implementation Retainer — $15,000 / month.** 3-month minimum. Available only to Diagnostic clients. We execute the prioritized fixes ourselves and re-measure recovery monthly.
   See: https://aetheris.technology/implementation

## Methodology
Two-page measurement methodology — sent to every prospect before pricing is discussed.
See: https://aetheris.technology/methodology

How we define a revenue leak, how we baseline (lead-to-contact, deal-stage progression, touch frequency), how we attribute recovered revenue (pre/post measurement of the same metric on the same population), what is in scope and what is out, and what an auditor would need to verify it.
